ALIGNED: same circle/capsule intent and visual outcome. Figma binds 9999px (variables cannot express a non-pixel circle). Both codebases use Tailwind rounded-full (calc(infinity * 1px)).

meta.note: Density + pixel radii aligned. Colors show each surface's reference pipeline and resolved output. MATCH = value + functionally equivalent refs (Figma Color/Blue/Light/10 ≡ code --sem-* → --color-blue-10). ALIGNED = same visual outcome, pipeline differs by surface. DEVIATE = value/intent differs.
meta.radiusFullNote: radius/full is ALIGNED (not MATCH, not DEVIATE): identical intent and visual outcome. Figma lists 9999px because variables cannot bind a non-pixel circle value. centric-ui + prototype use Tailwind rounded-full (calc(infinity * 1px)). Do not invent --radius-full: 9999px in code to force a string MATCH.
meta.colorPipeNote: Prefer matching reference structure across surfaces when the designer and engineering experiences allow. Naming may differ (Figma slash groups vs --sem-*); leaf primitives and intermediate semantics should agree. When a surface cannot host the other's form but intent + visual outcome match, use ALIGNED — not DEVIATE.
meta.radiusDensityNote: Radii semantic collection is density-modeled (Compact/Normal/Spacious) matching Proto. xxs floors at 2 (C=N=2, S=4). control-radius/sm|md alias radius/sm|md and inherit modes.
